_note: Owner decision Q57 / WP4. Every CIB&RC / PPQS document the citrus label extract in label_claims_citrus.csv must come from. A row is added to the CSV only from a document whose status is 'read', with its source_key, edition and page_ref; nothing is written from memory or from secondary sites. Brand names and maker links only from an official registrant list or the maker's own product page for that active ingredient.

crop_rules.santra: rows printed as citrus, mandarin, orange (acid lime / lemon rows excluded)
crop_rules.mosambi: rows printed as citrus, sweet orange, sweet lime, mosambi (acid lime / lemon rows excluded)

csv_columns: dose: the formulation cell, then '(a.i. <a.i. cell>)', both exactly as printed; ' per ha' (the printed column heading 'Dosage per ha' / 'Dosage/ha' / 'Dose/ha') is added only to a cell with no '/', '%' or 'ppm' of its own and only when no '**' footnote applies to the row. formulation_qty / dose_ai: the two printed cells. dilution: the printed cell ('Dilution in water (L)' under 'Dosage per ha'); a cell with its own unit (per tree, Lt, **) is kept as printed. phi_days: the printed waiting period when it is a whole number of days; 'NA' or '>6 months' is kept in description as 'Waiting period on label: ...'; '-' is left empty. description: only text the document prints for that row (method such as soil drench, footnote, strain, crop as printed). category: chemical | bio (by document). brand_names / maker_url: empty, because no official registrant list was reachable (ppqs.gov.in answers 403 to this environment).
